svg.text: composed val — D4 orbits, n ∈ {2, 4}, flat trace
NO MODEL INVOLVED — this is the training corpus. 12 scenes assembled by dm/data/composed.py from real QuickDraw sketches: one sketch (black) placed once, the same
sketch again as an exact mirror or quarter-turn of itself (orange), and unrelated sketches in the other cells (grey). These 12: 30.3% of bytes foldable to REPEATX by
construction, ratio 1.435; the 1,000-scene val split the runs were scored on: 40.9%
its D4 images — what REPEATX folds
